## Accepted theorem and exact scope

UNIQUENESS of the mixed-strategy equilibrium pair in explicitly encoded rational, variable-dimension bimatrix games with rank(A+B)=1 is coNP-complete. Arbitrary degeneracy is allowed. The reduction from PARTITION to NONUNIQUENESS has a known strict pure default equilibrium and another equilibrium exactly for yes instances. The independent certificate argument supplies the coNP-membership proof, including positive-dimensional equilibrium sets.

This addresses problem 30003934 / OWR-16413-005, priority rank 1171, on the first substantive approach. No hardness claim under a nondegeneracy promise is made. The proof also does not assert strong hardness, fixed-dimension hardness, or the distinct problem of equilibrium-payoff uniqueness.

## Complete proof and chronological review

The complete 13,596-byte proof, complete 15,545-byte certificate report, full 18,916-byte conditional mathematical audit, and subsequent 3,042-byte hash-specific final acceptance are included byte-for-byte. The early audit records the all-optimal-flow source-quantifier gap and all corrections. The later acceptance confirms that the unchanged final manuscript incorporates them and has no unresolved mathematical blocker. The edition acceptance explains the historical candidate header without editing the accepted proof.

A separate complete reading accepted the same scoped theorem. Acceptance rests on the written perturbation, residual-cycle uniqueness, injective simplex embedding, uniform all-minimizer exact penalty, rank-one equilibrium correspondence, strict default pair, full parameter coverage and polynomial binary encoding, together with the rational-certificate argument. Historical finite-check discussion remains in the full proof and audit, but no executable, fixture, separate result or log is distributed.

## Attribution and limits

The [rank-one parameter-family correspondence](https://doi.org/10.1287/opre.2020.1981) and [Disser–Skutella parametric-flow construction](https://doi.org/10.1145/3280847) are established prior work. The present written proof supplies the required all-optimal-flow strengthening and rank-preserving bridge; it does not infer that strengthening from the source corollary alone. The strict-default pattern is also known in unrestricted bimatrix-game hardness. Full attribution and bounded related-work review are included. No novelty, historical priority, or exhaustive current-open-status claim is made.

These are AI mathematical/source audits, not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant verification.

## Exact addition-only boundary

Add exactly eleven files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30003934/`. No QUEUE.md or unrelated file is changed. No copied third-party source documents, source text or images, datasets, derived source-text fingerprints, private sources, private storage paths or coordination files are included. Public PDF identities and inspection history are metadata only. Hashes and clean additive-patch replay check packaging integrity, not mathematical truth. Draft for review; no merge or release is requested.
